caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section of patterned design with three main horizontal bands. The central and widest band features a repeating pattern of large, tan maple leaves outlined and veined with a muted red color, scattered over a beige background with lighter beige highlights. Above and below this leaf motif is a narrow beige border with a row of small red dots. The top and bottom of the composition are bordered by a wide blue band. Each blue band contains alternating stylized floral shapes in tan and red, evenly spaced in a horizontal row. The blue bands and the central leaf motif are separated by the beige borders with red dots, creating clear divisions between the sections. The entire drawing sits on an off-white background.
title: Wall Paper Design
